title: Ohio Advocates Press FERC to Protect Ratepayers in Data Center Study Agreement

meta.summary:
Ohio’s ratepayer advocate is urging FERC to erect strong customer safeguards before allowing PJM to proceed with a largely untested approach to assess the expected transmission needs of a mammoth data center complex in the south of the state. 
 The post  Ohio Advocates Press FERC to Protect Ratepayers in Data Center Study Agreement  appeared first on  RTO Insider .
